note: Development set for Dyzania triage: 54 invented emails. Every person, firm, case number and address is made up. Labels were written BEFORE the triage code existed. 'expect' is what a careful person at the firm would want: category, final priority, whether the rule screen should see a time-sensitive date (urgency), whether a person must act (needsHuman), what kind of reply may be drafted (draftMode: none, acknowledgement = fixed text, standard = model draft), the queue, and the handoff. The set was written by the same person who wrote the code, so it is a regression set, not an independent test.

emails.subject: First consultation
emails.body: Hi, my husband and I are separating and I would like to know how much a first consultation costs and how I can book one. Thanks, Imogen Vance
